summary: USER-BUG ROUND VERIFIED — input-latch fix works end-to-end on /game/1-1 (landscape 844x390 web preview). (1) JUMP RELIABILITY [main bug]: 8/8 VERY quick taps on btn-jump (alternating ~10ms back-to-back mouse.down/up and 55ms holds, 350ms+ settle between) produced a visible airborne jump each time — verified by canvas pixel-diff in a tight character clip (idle noise floor 0-12px vs 1591-2132px per jump) with visible rise and landing between taps. Before the latch these sub-frame taps were dropped; now 8/8. (2) VARIABLE HEIGHT preserved: quick tap peak rise = 21px vs 500ms hold = 102px (head-tracked via bright-pixel row detection, star-noise excluded) — short hop vs full jump clearly distinct, JUMP_CUT still functional. (3) MOVEMENT NOT BROKEN BY LATCH: 400ms btn-right hold moved character right (diff 2005px) and it STOPPED after release (post-release drift diff 35px over 350ms window, no auto-walk); 1 quick ~15ms tap on btn-left produced a single nudge (746px diff) then full stop (48px drift). No sticky input from the latch. (4) PRESSED VISUALS: JUMP button purple border ring bbox 83px unpressed -> 74px pressed (ratio 0.89 = scale 0.9) with brighter #D580FF border/0.55 fill (r6_jump_pressed.jpeg); D-pad btn-right pressed bright-cyan ring 63x63px vs 72px layout (0.875 = scale 0.9) + pressed/unpressed visual diff 3488px (thicker 2.5px border + brighter fill clearly visible in r6_dpad_pressed2.jpeg). (5) PAUSE LATCH SAFETY: quick JUMP tap immediately followed by btn-pause -> resume via btn-resume; post-resume diffs 0/68px = no stale jump fired after resume (pause overlay screenshot r6_pause_overlay.jpeg). (6) REGRESSION: level 1-1 still completable — held btn-right 4.5s -> ESCAPED overlay with grade S, 3 stars, 'Echoes used: 0 - Par: 0', NEXT LEVEL/RETRY/LEVELS buttons all rendered (r6_escaped.jpeg); HUD timer counts down correctly (10.0s -> 9.78s after restart), ECHO 0/0 counter fine; character feet planted; only console errors are 2x pre-existing benign WebAudio autoplay warnings (synthetic CDP input doesn't unlock AudioContext on web — not a regression). HAPTICS: web-noop by design (Platform.OS==='web' bail in haptics.ts L53) — mapping verified in code only (jump/land=Medium, land_hard/laser/rewind=Heavy, death=Error, win=Success, new 'move'=selection tick fired on rest->move and direction flip in [id].tsx L180-184, per-button press haptics in controls.tsx setBtn L110); vibration itself must be verified by user on Android device.

critical_code_review_comments: Latch implementation is correct: bits set on every observed press in TouchControls.onChange ([id].tsx L407-415), merged live||latched into encodeInput (L120-124), cleared after exactly ONE delivered engine tick (L125), and cleared on pause (L97), retry (L359) and level-change init (L86). No stale-press path found; verified empirically via pause-resume test.

Latch does not break release semantics: engine consumes latched bit for one tick then live false takes over, so JUMP_CUT (engine.ts L544) still truncates quick taps into short hops — verified 21px vs 102px heights.

Edge note: if engine status != 'playing' the while-loop breaks BEFORE the merge (L114), so a latch bit could persist one extra frame until outcome/pause handlers clear it — harmless in practice because doRetry/setPaused both reset latchRef.
File size: [id].tsx is 794 lines (>700 split threshold) — overlays should be extracted; controls.tsx (389) and haptics.ts (89) are fine.
No deprecated Expo packages in touched files (expo-haptics is the current API). Only pre-existing RN-web deprecation console warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents) remain.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG RCA (confirmed fixed): game loop samples controlsRef only inside the fixed-timestep accumulator while-loop (60Hz). A tap whose down+up both land between two rAF-served engine ticks never sets controlsRef true at sample time -> jump silently dropped. FIX: latchRef accumulates every observed press in onChange; loop merges live||latched and clears latch after one delivered tick. Verified: 8/8 sub-16ms-class taps now produce jumps, no sticky movement after release, no stale fire across pause/resume.
